sources.name: INSPIRE Index Polygons July 2026 download
sources.current_evidence: Published 5 July 2026; files are refreshed on the first Sunday of each month.
sources.usage_limit: Indicative extent and position only; not a definitive title boundary and not a complete leasehold inventory.

sources.publisher: HM Land Registry / National Data Library
sources.name: INSPIRE Index Polygons metadata
sources.current_evidence: Last updated 8 July 2026; freehold registered property subset under the Open Government Licence.
sources.usage_limit: Metadata and access evidence only; duplicate polygons can occur at local-authority boundaries.

sources.name: Practice guide 10: official search of the index map
sources.current_evidence: Updated 20 July 2026; explains registered and unregistered land and the official index-map search route.
sources.usage_limit: Guidance does not bind the internal parcel IDs to legal title extents.

sources.name: LSOA December 2021 Boundaries EW BGC V5
sources.current_evidence: Generalised 20 metre coastal-clipped boundaries; V5 includes LSOA21CD and LSOA21NM identifiers.
sources.usage_limit: Statistical geography, not a property boundary.

sources.name: LSOA December 2021 Boundaries EW BFC V10
sources.current_evidence: Full-resolution coastal-clipped LSOA boundaries; National Data Library page updated 21 October 2025.
sources.usage_limit: Large 588 MB source; use for boundary-edge adjudication, not as a parcel polygon.

sources.name: LSOA population estimates mid-2022 revised to mid-2024
sources.current_evidence: Accredited official statistics released 7 November 2025; usual-resident population by LSOA.
sources.usage_limit: Edition and LSOA-code compatibility must pass before rate calculation.

sources.name: LSOA population density mid-2024
sources.current_evidence: Accredited official statistics released 7 November 2025; density edition covers mid-2022 revised to mid-2024.
sources.usage_limit: Contextual denominator check only; density is not a crime measurement.

sources.name: Police.uk crime last updated
sources.current_evidence: Official API reports the latest available crime month as 2026-05-01.
sources.usage_limit: Month selection only; no score is derived from this endpoint.

sources.name: Street-level crimes API contract
sources.current_evidence: Supports point-radius or polygon queries and an explicit YYYY-MM parameter.
sources.usage_limit: Locations are anonymised approximations and must not be described as exact parcel incidents.

sources.name: Stop and searches by area API contract
sources.current_evidence: Supports point-radius or polygon queries with an optional YYYY-MM parameter.
sources.usage_limit: Approximate locations; policing activity is not interchangeable with crime incidence.

sources.name: Police recorded crime and outcomes open data tables
sources.current_evidence: Last updated 23 April 2026; includes PFA, CSP, offence and outcomes tables.
sources.usage_limit: PFA and CSP totals cannot be copied to individual parcels.

sources.name: Crime outcomes year to December 2025
sources.usage_limit: Outcome statistics are not a parcel-level exposure measure.

sources.name: Local police recorded crime data
sources.current_evidence: Last updated 8 July 2026; rolling twelve-month CSP and offence-code totals.
sources.usage_limit: Area totals require geographic and temporal reconciliation and are not parcel measurements.

sources.name: Police recorded crime and outcomes open data user guide
sources.current_evidence: Method and usage guide updated 30 January 2025.
sources.usage_limit: Use to constrain interpretation; it does not supply parcel values.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
sources.name: English indices of deprivation 2025
sources.current_evidence: Published 30 October 2025 and updated 17 November 2025; official relative deprivation statistics for small areas in England.
sources.usage_limit: Relative deprivation evidence, not a current monthly crime rate.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
sources.name: IoD 2025 File 7 ranks, scores, deciles and denominators
sources.current_evidence: Updated 17 November 2025; includes LSOA 2021 code, Crime Score, Crime Rank, Crime Decile and population denominators.
sources.usage_limit: Candidate method requires calibration and browser acceptance before business promotion.
